import json, os, pathlib, sys
sys.path.insert(0, str(pathlib.Path.cwd() / "src"))
import flask
import flask.cli
import werkzeug.serving
os.environ.pop("FLASK_RUN_FROM_CLI", None)
os.environ.pop("FLASK_DEBUG", None)
flask.cli.show_server_banner = lambda *args, **kwargs: None
observations = []
for case in json.load(sys.stdin):
    app = flask.Flask("frozen_server_observer")
    app.config["SERVER_NAME"] = case.get("server_name")
    app.debug = case.get("initial_debug", False)
    app._got_first_request = True
    observed = {"id": case["id"]}
    def observe(host, port, application, **options):
        observed.update(host=host, port=port, debug=app.debug, options=options, same_application=application is app)
        if case.get("server_error"):
            raise RuntimeError("frozen-server-error")
    werkzeug.serving.run_simple = observe
    try:
        app.run(host=case.get("host"), port=case.get("port"), debug=case.get("debug"), load_dotenv=False, **case.get("options", {}))
    except Exception as error:
        observed["error"] = {"type": type(error).__name__, "message": str(error)}
    observed["cleaned_up"] = app._got_first_request is False
    observations.append(observed)
print(json.dumps(observations, sort_keys=True))
